name: File and Directory Discovery
summary: Adversaries may enumerate files and directories or search in specific device locations for desired information within a filesystem. Adversaries may use the information from File and Directory Discovery during automated discovery to shape follow-on behaviors, including deciding if the adversary should fully infect the target and/or attempt specific actions. strategies.name: Detection of File and Directory Discovery

analytics.name: Analytic 1788
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect File and Directory Discovery by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; File Access via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: opendir() or File.listFiles() on path IN $ExternalStoragePaths$ called > $FileEnumThreshold$ times within $EnumWindow$ by app NOT IN $FileEnumAllowList$]; Network Traffic Flow via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN…
